171223595.title: File:Zumenon (estradiol hemihydrate) tablets in Australia, with one obverse and one reverse blister packs.jpg

ObjectName.value: Zumenon (estradiol hemihydrate) tablets in Australia, with one obverse and one reverse blister packs

Categories.value: Estradiol|Self-published work

ImageDescription.value:
The packaging of Zumenon (estradiol hemihydrate) tablets sold in Australia. It reads: "Prescription only medicine, keep out of reach of children. Zumenon, estradiol 2 mg (as hemihydrate). 56 film coated tablets".

Beside the packaging are two blister packs, with 28 spaces of tablets each. The one on top is in its obverse position, and the other one below is in its reverse position.

The reverse pack has the days of the week on each row, with arrows pointing from one day to the next. It has the text "Zumenon®, estradiol 2mg (as hemihydrate), Viatras" on it, along with the identifier "1137694" on the bottom right, and the text "376714 EXP 10 2027" to the left of it.
